title: Strong Junior/Middle Full Stack Angular/.NET Developer
description:
The Role
We’re looking for a Strong Junior/Middle Full Stack Angular/.NET Developer who is eager to learn, grow, and contribute to real-world projects from day one. This is a great opportunity if you have a solid foundation in programming and want to put your skills into practice while building modern, user-friendly applications.

In this role, you’ll work closely with experienced developers, gaining hands-on experience in Angular, .NET Core, and MS SQL. You’ll be part of a supportive team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

📋Key Responsibilities
Assist in identifying and fixing bugs and issues in the codebase
Contribute to front-end development using Angular by designing and implementing user-friendly interfaces
Support database maintenance tasks, including writing SQL queries and helping optimize performance
Participate in code reviews with more experienced developers to learn best practices and coding standards
Help refactor existing code to improve efficiency, readability, and maintainability
Collaborate closely with senior developers, gaining hands-on experience and guidance in both front-end and back-end development

📝Requirements
Completed or ongoing Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
Solid understanding of software development principles and best practices
Demonstrated coding skills with pet projects available on GitHub (or similar platform), preferably in C#
Hands-on (non-commercial) experience with:.NET Core (EF Core, MVC, Onion Architecture, or CQRS)
SQL databases

English proficiency at B2+ level
Availability for a full-time schedule: 12:00 – 20:30 (Mon–Fri, including a 30-minute lunch break)
Willingness to participate in regular team meetings during working hours
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
Experience with Angular (or any other JS) framework

﻿﻿What We Offer﻿
📈 Growth opportunities — clear paths for professional development and career advancement﻿
🔋 Supportive culture — a friendly, collaborative environment where your ideas matter﻿﻿
🖥️ Modern projects — work with cutting-edge technologies on meaningful, real-world applications﻿
💡 Talented team — join a motivated group of professionals who are always ready to share knowledge and help you grow

Join our team at SoftPlus Ukraine and contribute to the success of our innovative projects.
Apply now!
